skill.name: updating-a-notion-page
skill.description: Prepare one bounded update to an existing Notion-backed record using fresh fetch, exact merge, selected-field payload, confirmation, single-use start, and read-after-write verification. Use for existing record properties or supported body content; do not use for create, delete, or another provider.
skill.shortDescription: Safely update selected fields while preserving everything else.
skill.defaultPrompt: Use $updating-a-notion-page to prepare this exact existing-record change with fresh state, private review, and preservation checks.

instructions: Resolve one exact existing record identity, portable record type, selected Notion mapping, instance authority, current schema, and exact lock.
Identify every requested field and distinguish mapped record properties from structured document body content.
Reject deletion, unsupported body transforms, and any field absent from Context or the provider mapping.
flexibility: Ask for the exact record or selected fields when the request does not identify them unambiguously.
stopConditions: Stop when record identity, update surface, mapping, authority, or supported capability is ambiguous.

instructions: Fetch the current exact record and, when applicable, its current body before deriving any overwrite, edit, replacement, or append.
Capture the provider version or normalized fingerprint used for compare-before-write.
Read every selected current value and the preservation facts required by the workflow; never use a cached value or the value originally supplied by the requester.
stopConditions: Stop when current state, version, selected value, or body representation cannot be established.

instructions: Derive the exact replacement from the freshly observed value and scope the portable patch to selected fields only.
For append, prove the addition is not already present and preserve the complete current value before adding the normalized separator and content.
Keep unselected properties out of the update payload and bind explicit preservation requirements separately.
stopConditions: Stop when the change is already present, conflicts with current state, or cannot be represented idempotently.

instructions: Prepare exact private before and proposed values, selected-field scope, compare precondition, verification criteria, and recovery behavior.
Expose only nullable fingerprints and stable reason codes in sanitized inspection.
State which properties or body regions remain untouched and whether the provider sequence lacks external atomicity.
flexibility: Present several selected fields together only when one immutable batch binds each before and proposed value.
stopConditions: Stop before approval when exact private review or same-authority verification cannot be produced.

instructions: Create an expiring request from the exact immutable update and private review material, then record the operator's exact confirmation separately.
Consume that confirmation once into one durable checkpoint only after revalidating lock, current version, provider route, and verification plan.
Require a new request when any selected field, value, version, body, mapping, or route changes.
stopConditions: Stop when write policy, approval, confirmation, consumption, or checkpoint validation does not permit the exact effect.

instructions: Compare the exact current version, apply only the approved selected fields or body transform, and emit the write once.
Re-fetch and verify every approved value plus all declared preservation invariants from a source newer than the write.
Enter needs-attention on write or verification ambiguity; never blind retry or report rollback without verified compensation.
stopConditions: Stop and reconcile when the observed record matches neither the approved nor prior exact state.

verification: The update binds one exact record, mapping, authority, current version, and selected surface.
The proposed value is derived from a fresh read and append idempotency is established.
Only selected properties or the exact supported body region enter the write payload.
The human decision binds private before and proposed values through one exact request and single-use start.
A fresh read proves both the intended change and every declared preservation invariant.

gotchas.summary: Provider updates replace a property's complete value, so a blind append or edit can destroy existing content.
gotchas.countermeasure: Fetch, merge locally, compare the current version, and send only the exact complete selected replacement.

gotchas.summary: A label such as Description can denote a mapped property or structured page body, which require different capabilities and verification.
gotchas.countermeasure: Resolve the surface from the current schema and body contract before compilation.

gotchas.summary: Repeating an append without checking current state duplicates the content.
gotchas.countermeasure: Prove absence before deriving the append and never retry an ambiguous write.

gotchas.summary: Echoing unselected fields back to the provider can overwrite newer values with stale copies.
gotchas.countermeasure: Keep unselected fields structurally absent from the patch and verify preservation separately.

gotchas.summary: A text replacement can return success while an escaped or normalized source string fails to match.
gotchas.countermeasure: Derive the exact old representation from the fresh read and verify the edited region character-for-character afterward.

limitations: This guide intentionally replaces host-qualified direct writes with the portable connected approval, one-time start, checkpoint, verification, and reconciliation boundary.
It remains a preview-only candidate and grants no provider call or write authority.
